rows.detail: objective: Increase viable macrophage production while maintaining viability.
ipsc_macrophage v1.0.0: 12 parameters, 7 readouts, simulator current

Species: human · Cell type: monocyte, macrophage, iPSC-derived macrophage · State: differentiating, mature · Excluded: mouse-only evidence. In-scope evidence ranks first; out-of-scope evidence is shown separately and labelled a context mismatch.

evidence_gap GAP-mcsf_ng_ml: Nothing in this project says whether the current M-CSF setting is limiting the objective, so a revision would move it blind. This question was chosen by BioSense, not stated in the request.

simulated: Every number in `effects` was produced by the project's mechanistic stand-in and is labelled SIMULATED. It is not a meas
at least one effect carries a magnitude with provenance
Test M-CSF at 20, 50, 80 ng/mL against the current process, measuring monocytes per input ipsc, harvested cells, final viability.
7 step(s), every number resolving to a structured fact
no private lineage; safe to publish

note: This is a SYSTEM CAPABILITY scorecard. It records whether BioSense identified an uncertainty, planned an analysis, executed it deterministically, quantified what it could, checked simulator coverage and labelled every number. It does NOT measure biological truth, and a run can pass every row while being biologically wrong.
